spans.s: पुण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Holy, sacred, पुण्यं यायास्त्रिभुवनगुरोर्धाम चंडीश्वरस्य Megh.i.33, R.iii.41; 2. virtuous, meritorious; 3. propitious, favourable, lucky, auspicious, M.ii.30; 4. beautiful, pleasing; 5. sweet, fragrant; 6. solemn, festive.
पुण्य (II) n. 1. Religious or moral merit, virtue, R.i.69; 2. a meritorious act; 3. purity, purification; 4. a trough for watering cattle.

पुण्य (I) a. (f. ण्या) 1. Holy, sacred, पुण्यं यायास्त्रिभुवनगुरोर्धाम चंडीश्वरस्य Megh.i.33, R.iii.41; 2. virtuous, meritorious; 3. propitious, favourable, lucky, auspicious, M.ii.30; 4. beautiful, pleasing; 5. sweet, fragrant; 6. solemn, festive.
पुण्या f. The holy basil.
पुण्य-अह n. an auspicious day, पुण्याहं व्रज मंगलं सुदिवसं प्रातः प्रयातस्य ते Am.
पुण्य-अह˚वाचन n. repeating ‘this is an auspicious day’ three times at the beginning of certain religious ceremonies.
पुण्य-उद्यान a. having beautiful gardens.
पुण्य-कर्तृ m. a virtuous man.
पुण्य-कर्मन् n. a meritorious act.
पुण्य-काल m. an auspicious time.
पुण्य-कीर्ति a. auspicious fame, famous, celebrated, Bt.i.5.
पुण्य-कृत् a. meritorious, virtuous.
पुण्य-कृत्या f. a meritorious deed.
पुण्य-क्षेत्र n. holy land, i.e. Āryāvarta.
पुण्य-गंध (I) a. sweet-scented.
पुण्य-गंध (II) m. the champaka tree.
पुण्य-गंधि a. sweet-scented.
पुण्य-गृह n. 1. an alms house; 2. a temple.
पुण्य-जन m. 1. a demon, a goblin; 2. a yaksha, R.iii.60; 3. a virtuous man.
पुण्य-जन˚ईश्वर m. an epithet of Kubera, अनुययौ यमपुण्यजनेश्वरौ R.ix.6.
पुण्य-जित a. attained by good works.
पुण्य-तीर्थ n. a holy place of pilgrimage.
पुण्य-दर्शन (I) m. the blue jay.
पुण्य-दर्शन (II) n. visiting holy shrines.
पुण्य-पुरुष m. a man rich in moral merit.
पुण्य-प्रताप m. the efficacy of moral merit.
पुण्य-फल (I) n. the reward of good works.
पुण्य-फल (II) m. a grove.
पुण्य-भाज् a. blessed, meritorious.
पुण्य-भू, -भूमि f. the holy land, i.e. Āryāvarta.
पुण्य-भू, -भूमि f. the holy land, i.e. Āryāvarta.
पुण्य-रात्र m. an auspicious night.
पुण्य-लोक m. heaven, paradise.
पुण्य-वत् a. 1. virtuous, meritorious; 2. fortunate, lucky; 3. happy.
पुण्य-शकुन (I) m. a bird of good omen.
पुण्य-शकुन (II) n. an auspicious omen.
पुण्य-शील a. piously inclined, virtuous, pious, righteous.
पुण्य-श्लोक (I) a. of good fame.
पुण्य-श्लोक (II) m. an epithet of Nala, Yudhiṣṭhira and Kṛṣṇa.
पुण्य-श्लोका f. 1. an epithet of Sītā; 2. of Draupadī.
पुण्य-स्थान n. a sacred place, a place of pilgrimage.
पूण् vt. 10U (pres. पूणयति-ते) To heap together, to accumulate.
